name: Local Structure Example
description:
Adds a compact weathered stone shrine to newly generated Overworld terrain. Copy the complete 03_adv_18_local_structure folder into lua_scripts so its manifest, entrypoint, and JSON template stay together.

Explore new chunks and look for a broken cobblestone foundation surrounding a tall central pillar with a glowstone beacon. Roughly one in sixteen chunks is eligible, and each eligible chunk tries up to four safe surface positions before giving up. Craft a Shrine Surveyor from a compass and glowstone dust to find eligible chunks and their four candidate centers. Terrain conditions can still reject a candidate. Each shrine selects its transform and weathering deterministically.
